objective: Implement the transferred accounting UX findings without changing accounting lifecycle, authorization, or file-download routes.

items.before: Accounting remediation links could drop the current interface language when opening finance, approval, document, invoice, or billing-setup destinations.
items.after: Accounting review links retain lang while preserving existing view, stage, fragment, and scoped record parameters; artifact and PDF download URLs are unchanged.
items.browserEvidence: Passed after coordinated rebuild in the targeted 20/20 run across all four viewport projects; remediation language assertions pass. See /home/kripta/ja-ux-evidence-20261011/round2-projects/accounting-run-after-stale-collapse.log.

items.before: Accounting Pack status filters left final and stale states untranslated.
items.after: RecordBrowser status options and the active filter summary show localized Final and Stale labels while retaining the original state values.
items.browserEvidence: Passed after coordinated rebuild: Spanish final/stale option labels and retained status value are asserted. See /home/kripta/ja-ux-evidence-20261011/round2-projects/accounting-run-after-stale-collapse.log.

items.before: New Accounting Packs always selected English even when the portal was in Spanish or Portuguese.
items.after: The report language defaults from the portal locale, and a failed submission restores its submitted dates and report locale.
items.browserEvidence: Passed after coordinated rebuild: English, Spanish and Portuguese defaults plus submitted-value retention after validation. See /home/kripta/ja-ux-evidence-20261011/round2-projects/accounting-run-after-stale-collapse.log.

items.before: Each pack repeated status, preview, retry, warning, finalization, and localized-PDF controls inline, creating a long mobile register.
items.after: Ready downloads stay visible beside queued, processing, and failed status badges in a localized status/download group; stale-source state has a localized warning badge outside the disclosure, and secondary controls start closed for ordinary stale packs while active problems, download notices, retries, previews, and failed exports stay reachable.
items.browserEvidence: Passed on final coordinated build: all rendered pending badges are visible outside disclosures, the status/download group has a localized accessible name, ready downloads remain visible, and a clean stale pack begins collapsed with its localized outside badge. 20/20 accounting scenarios passed across all four viewport projects in /home/kripta/ja-ux-evidence-20261011/round2-projects/release-accounting-ui-final.log. Pending-status screenshot: /home/kripta/ja-ux-evidence-20261011/release-accounting-artifacts-final/phone-390-accounting-pending.png; final full-page screenshots across all widths remain in /home/kripta/ja-ux-evidence-20261011/round2-projects/after.

items.before: Pack articles had no period heading associated with their accessible region.
items.after: Each article exposes its period as an h3 and references that heading through aria-labelledby.
items.browserEvidence: Passed after coordinated rebuild: every rendered pack has an h3 period heading associated with its article. See /home/kripta/ja-ux-evidence-20261011/round2-projects/accounting-run-after-stale-collapse.log.

items.before: Auditors had no clear explanation of their accounting access level.
items.after: The accounting header shows localized read-only access guidance, while existing auditor controls remain disabled.
items.browserEvidence: Passed after coordinated rebuild: Portuguese read-only auditor guidance is visible and write controls are absent. See /home/kripta/ja-ux-evidence-20261011/round2-projects/accounting-run-after-stale-collapse.log.
